title: Temperature Control of a Water Heater Using Integral Feedback and Frequency-Domain Analysis
expert_review: A realistic thermal control problem illustrating integral control design and robustness analysis using Bode and Nyquist plots.
learning_objectives: Model thermal systems using first-order dynamics
Design integral controllers for temperature regulation
Apply Bode plots to assess robustness
